params.body:
## What

The pipeline moves its pinned Gentells Standard from v0.10.0 to v0.11.0.

- `bin/sync-standard.mjs`: `STANDARD_REF` is now `v0.11.0`. `packages/core/standard.mjs` and `test/fixtures/standard-conformance.json` are regenerated from the tag (sha-256:ed0ef874d4f).
- `packages/core/standard-rules.mjs`: `trendHolds` gets the new condition. A trend holds only when, besides 5 supporting signals from 3 sources, at least 3 signals support it outright, from at least 2 sources. The answer keeps its shape, so `supportOf`, the Studio's story starters and `insights-rows` need no change.

## Why

Standard 0.11.0 (gentells-standard #15): partial matches add up, but cannot carry a trend alone. The first trend the support judge passed under 0.10.0 held on 1 outright support and 10 partial matches out of 84 signals. A hand read of all 84 verdicts confirmed the judge was fair, so the trend was thin and the rule let it through. Under 0.11.0 it is a lead, and the Studio stops offering it as a finding.

## Tests

- `test/standard.test.mjs` runs the standard's conformance cases against the pipeline's port, including the three new holds cases.
- Full suite: 1191 of 1197; the 6 failures are the known report-render tests that need Chromium, unchanged.
params.title: Standard 0.11.0: a trend holds on outright support
